answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 20769 Country: India Title: I would like to know if a woman is divourced by her husband who will have the custody of the kids. Does it depend upon the gender of the kid? Question: Assalam Alaykum. I would like to know if a woman is divourced by her husband who will have the custody of the kids. Does it depend upon the gender of the kid? ThankYou in Advance. Answer ID: 20769 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 404/404/M=1431) A mother has right to nourish her children, if it is a boy then up to seven years and if it is a girl then up to nine years, while the father is responsible for their expenses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
